Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $90 in August?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (7% odds) on crude reach $90. Closes in 4d. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.

Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $70 in August?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (1% odds) on crude drop below $70. Closes in 4d. A move this low would ease diesel and nitrogen input cost pressure heading into side-dress and summer ops.
